items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: I said, 'Well, they're all people who are very well known, they're famous people,' I said, 'Momma's not famous.'

ctx.x: He wasn't too excited. He said, 'Well, that's nice.' He says, 'Well, yeah, that's nice.' And he says, 'Well, I tell you what, right now I don't have any calls for what you're doing right now,' but he says, 'I tell you, if I find a way I can help you, I'll give you a call.' So that was the end of that. And I never did see him anymore or hear from him anymore until the March of Dimes show, which is the show where I was discovered. This was at the Hollywood High School in Hollywood. And when he came to this affair…
